description: List tracked ecosystem events — without filters, counts per event type over the last 7 days plus the latest event of each type and a plain-word legend; set event_type or canonical_key for the full feed (limit/offset page through it), set since=YYYY-MM-DD to widen the window. Read-only aggregation of daily-collected observatory data; no side effects. For counts rather than the feed use the `get_*_summary` tools. Use when the user asks what changed recently in the ecosystem.
name: get_ecosystem_events
title: Get Ecosystem Events
